'''Paak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a member of the [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]] which formed on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] following the end of the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] in the years following the passage of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], Paak was distinguished by his green and purple facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]]. When Paak joined the [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]], Paak was stationed as a guard at the underground base of the organization and was wary of a newcomer named [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Rainah]]. He and fellow member [[Kelad'den]] did not see eye to eye on the views held by the Front. After a [[Kidnap attempt on Serenno|failed abducting attempt]] on former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], Paak and his comrade [[Cyndra]] fled the base.<ref name="DBROT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

Later, after regrouping at coordinates provided by their leader [[Hetton]], Paak and Cyndra escorted Rainah to meet with Hetton. During the meeting, after Cyndra was driven insane by [[Sith sorcery/Legends|sorcery]] produced by Rainah, who was revealed to be [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], Paak attempted to kill the newcomer as he fired his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at her, but the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] deflected his shot back towards him, which immediately killed him.<ref name="DBROT" />
